Sant’aggivessanā.g: kasmā ārabhi? Ayaṁ ucchedaladdhiko attano laddhiṁ nigūhati, tassā pana laddhiyā vaṇṇe vuccamāne attano laddhiṁ pātukarissatīti tisso laddhiyo ekato dassetvā vibhajituṁ imaṁ desanaṁ ārabhi.
